Reproducible builds for parquet-writer.

- `parquet-writer.wasm` is now byte-identical to a local `./build.sh`. The parquet crate's hashing library (ahash) baked a random seed into each build, so v0.12.0's `parquet-writer.wasm` could not be rebuilt bit for bit. Builds now set `CONST_RANDOM_SEED`, in `build.sh` and in the CI and release workflows. The module works the same; only the seed used for dictionary encoding is now fixed.

The other modules are unchanged and byte-identical to v0.12.0. Every file is built on GitHub from the tagged source, byte-identical to a local `./build.sh`, with `SHA256SUMS` and a signed build attestation.
